How close can Landsat-only models get?

No land-cover class labels, class areas, or class proportions enter these four models. Landsat remains contextual ~30 m data shared by many smaller aerial objects. Bottom-up methods use object area only to convert a satellite-conditioned unit rate into a contribution.

Best Landsat-only point result: landsat_only_bottomup_nonnegative with monthly MAE 3.940 kgal. It improves on the mean curve by only 0.059 kgal; the paired 95% interval is [-0.197, 0.297] and includes zero. It trails the seasonally regularized land-cover model by 0.273 kgal; the paired interval for land-cover minus Landsat is [-0.686, 0.103]. Landsat-only cosine similarity remains close to the reference models, so it recovers the broad seasonal pattern better than parcel-specific magnitude. All preprocessing and tuning are confined to outer-training parcels.

Parcel trajectory ridge

Area-weight monthly NDVI/NDMI/EVI to each parcel, regularize a linear 36-feature mapping, and predict all months.

Parcel trajectory random forest

Area-weight monthly NDVI/NDMI/EVI to each parcel and use one multi-output forest for all months.

Bottom-up nonnegative Landsat response

Estimate one nonnegative monthly unit-area response to continuous Landsat values, multiply by object area, and sum.

Bottom-up signed Landsat response

Use the same object equation but allow Landsat-conditioned unit-area contributions to reduce metered demand.

Satellite support

60 Landsat supports serve 13,019 aerial objects; shared pixels are preserved. Variables are monthly 2021 NDVI, NDMI, and EVI after Collection 2 scaling and QA filtering.
